title: Vertical rod
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw the first face of the 2D sketch. Begin with the first loop, which consists of four arcs and eight lines. The first arc starts at coordinates (0.0, 0.0004), has a midpoint at (0.0001, 0.0001), and ends at (0.0004, 0.0). The first line starts at the end of the first arc and extends to (0.0099, 0.0). The second arc starts at (0.0099, 0.0), has a midpoint at (0.0102, 0.0001), and ends at (0.0103, 0.0004). The second line starts at the end of the second arc and goes to (0.0103, 0.0032). The third line starts at (0.0103, 0.0032) and ends at (0.01, 0.0032). The fourth line starts at (0.01, 0.0032) and ends at (0.01, 0.0006). The third arc starts at (0.01, 0.0006), has a midpoint at (0.0099, 0.0004), and ends at (0.0096, 0.0003). The fifth line starts at (0.0096, 0.0003) and extends to (0.0006, 0.0003). The fourth arc starts at (0.0006, 0.0003), has a midpoint at (0.0004, 0.0004), and ends at (0.0003, 0.0006). The sixth line starts at (0.0003, 0.0006) and goes to (0.0003, 0.0019). The seventh line starts at (0.0003, 0.0019) and ends at (0.0, 0.0019). The eighth line starts at (0.0, 0.0019) and ends at (0.0, 0.0004). After completing the 2D sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.0103 to the entire sketch. Then, transform the scaled 2D sketch into 3D by rotating it using Euler angles set to zero and translating it using a translation vector set to zero. Finally, extrude the 2D sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the vertical rod with a cylindrical top and rectangular base are: length of 0.010265292328489354 meters, width of 0.0031683001013856032 meters, and height of 0.75 meters.

reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane()

# Add arcs and lines to the sketch
sketch = sketch.moveTo(0.0, 0.0004).threePointArc((0.0001, 0.0001), (0.0004, 0.0))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0099, 0.0)
sketch = sketch.threePointArc((0.0102, 0.0001), (0.0103, 0.0004))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0103, 0.0032)
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.01, 0.0032)
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.01, 0.0006)
sketch = sketch.threePointArc((0.0099, 0.0004), (0.0096, 0.0003))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0006, 0.0003)
sketch = sketch.threePointArc((0.0004, 0.0004), (0.0003, 0.0006))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0003, 0.0019)
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0, 0.0019)
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0, 0.0004)

# Close the sketch
sketch = sketch.close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = sketch.extrude(0.75)
